label: Visual Ambiguity
description: Target image resembles hundreds of visually similar photos (e.g. waterfalls, pets, sunsets)

label: Temporal Vagueness
description: User has fuzzy or inaccurate recollection of date/year, or scanned photos lack EXIF dates

label: Metadata Void
description: Missing GPS location, missing camera metadata, or imported media without creation timestamps

label: Semantic Gap
description: Vocabulary mismatch between mental model and search index (e.g. actions, emotional states)

label: OCR / Text Failure
description: Inability to detect legible text on receipts, serial numbers, signage, or tilted documents

label: Face Grouping Failure
description: Omission of known persons wearing sunglasses, hats, masks, or extreme angles

label: Compound Query Failure
description: Search interprets multi-subject queries as OR instead of AND (e.g. Mom and Grandma)

label: Search Abandonment
description: Cognitive fatigue from infinite feed scrolling leading to permanent abandonment
